_note: Hijab images, in the order of the Beaded Charcoal Black Net Hijab: three-quarter view, front view, close-up. Text as agreed in chat: opening paragraph, adult mannequin in a white shirt, and close-up B (decoration) or, for a plain hijab, close-up A (hero-3-plain). {colour} is filled in by the program. The close-ups leave out transparency and light shining through the fabric: that wording got them blocked by Google's safety filter (Nov 1).

hero-1.title: Three-quarter view
hero-1.prompt:
Use the attached product photo as the only reference for the hijab. Recreate this exact hijab without any change: the same colour and shade, fabric, weave and transparency, print or dye pattern, edge finish and size, exactly as in the photo. If the photo shows several colours, use only this colour: {colour}.

The reference photo may contain a brand logo, watermark, text or label, for example in a corner, across the image or printed on a tag. These are not part of the product. Do not copy them: remove them completely, recreate the fabric or background underneath as if they were never there, and do not add any other logo, text or watermark anywhere in the new image.

Do not add any detail, decoration or element that is not in the photo, and do not remove, simplify or redesign anything that is. Photorealistic luxury fashion photography, true-to-life colour, sharp focus on the hijab, natural fabric drape.

The hijab is shown on a life-size adult female display mannequin, the size of a grown woman (about 170 cm tall in full), seen from the waist up: a full adult torso with broad, softly rounded shoulders, a defined bust and waist, and an adult-sized head and neck in true proportion to the body. The mannequin is smooth matte warm-ivory with a completely featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth). It wears a plain white long-sleeved shirt with a high round neckline, fitted neatly with no print, buttons, pockets or logo, so no mannequin skin shows below the neck. The hijab is the only accessory: no niqab, no cap visible, no jewellery, no pins showing. It is wrapped neatly around the head as an adult woman would wear it, framing the oval of the face, covering the top and back of the head and the whole neck, with the fabric falling over the shoulders and down onto the chest of the white shirt, so its true size, colour, texture and edges are clearly visible against the white.

Three-quarter view of the mannequin from the waist up, showing how the hijab wraps around the side of the head and falls over one shoulder and down the arm of the white shirt. Seamless warm ivory studio backdrop, soft diffused light. Vertical 4:5 image.
